description: Source code for Netty-based RPC environment in Apache Spark, including classes for environment setup, endpoint references, message handling, and network communication.

classes.name: NettyRpcEnv
classes.description: Represents the RPC environment using Netty, managing server, clients, endpoints, and message dispatching.

classes.name: NettyRpcEnvFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of NettyRpcEnv based on configuration.

classes.name: NettyRpcEndpointRef
classes.description: Reference to an RPC endpoint, supporting message sending and request handling.

classes.name: RequestMessage
classes.description: Represents a serialized message sent between RPC endpoints.

classes.name: RpcFailure
classes.description: Indicates a failure response in RPC communication.

classes.name: NettyRpcHandler
classes.description: Handles incoming network messages, connection events, and dispatches to registered endpoints.

methods.name: createClientBootstraps
methods.description: Creates list of client bootstrap objects, including authentication if enabled.

methods.name: startServer
methods.description: Starts the RPC server on specified address and port.

methods.name: setupEndpoint
methods.description: Registers an RPC endpoint with the environment.

methods.name: asyncSetupEndpointRefByURI
methods.description: Asynchronously sets up an endpoint reference by URI.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message to a remote or local endpoint.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a network client for a given address.

methods.name: askAbortable
methods.description: Sends a request expecting a reply, with abort and timeout handling.

methods.name: ask
methods.description: Sends a request expecting a reply, returning a Future.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes ByteBuffer into object of type T.

methods.name: endpointRef
methods.description: Returns a reference to a given RPC endpoint.

methods.name: awaitTermination
methods.description: Waits for termination of the environment.

methods.name: openChannel
methods.description: Opens a readable byte channel for a given URI.
